scope: Reconstruct original first-partial PAPER cash before runner intake/preparation and terminal/cohort/policy consumption. Preserve fixed0.1 SOL PAPER, uncapped runners and runtime OFF. No LIVE size, operator model/policy/provider/wallet/order changes.
source_grain: One original quoted PAPER entry and exactly one original first-partial exit receipt, each with its own original FX and event clock. Subsequent prospective arms are independently owned.

finding.evidence: Original runner intake retained the primary entry/first-partial receipts. Case preparation copied scalar realized proceeds and fees but dropped exit_fill_events. Terminal replay started from those scalars rather than independently reconstructing their original cash.
finding.risk: A changed shared realized prefix could contaminate prospective runner net PnL and its financial policy comparison; a recomputed intake hash alone is not cash conservation.
finding.repair: Require original typed buy/partial FX, strict raw quantities, a complete one-fill population and original quoted cash/fees at their own clocks; retain the sanitized original exit receipt in case/arm prefixes and independently reconstruct prefix cash before terminal replay. Legacy/unproved originals remain preserved but excluded from financial runner enrollment.

financial_contract.entry: Checked original buy identity/signature,0.1 SOL and100000000 input lamports, entry quote/mints/age, frozen adverse slippage/raw output, entry FX at its own opening/valuation clock.
financial_contract.partial: Exactly one original successful PAPER partial receipt; matching intent/signature, original quantity-before/sold/left, first-partial/capture clocks, reverse quote/mints/limit/age, original fill FX and normalized executed PAPER price.
financial_contract.cash: Recompute SOL proceeds from exact quote output less frozen slippage; USD proceeds from the partial's original FX; buy fee valued with original entry FX plus partial fee valued with original partial FX. Recheck optional primary derived accounting and retain immutable proof equality across counterfactual arms.
financial_contract.limitation: Recorded estimated PAPER quote cash is not independent provider authentication, actual live execution/depth, prospective full-strategy profitability or exhaustive opportunity coverage. There is no historical proof backfill.

population_observation.limitation: The inspected population is empty. The repair and tests do not establish any real winning trade or profitable current run.
